assumptions.purpose: Discovery scanner: which chart should be opened first, not a buy/sell signal.
assumptions.universe: Canadian-listed instruments from reviewed universe; CAD only by construction.
assumptions.stagePrinciple: Stage describes chart maturity; evidence ranks candidates inside a stage.
assumptions.earlyWatch: Prior weakness near a recent low plus fresh evidence of downside exhaustion/reclaim; no full reversal confirmation required.
assumptions.dedupe: Backtest evaluates first stage episodes and suppresses same-symbol same-stage overlap for each forward horizon.
assumptions.ranking: Stage-specific evidence score is fixed before reading outcomes; Recovery keeps base score for eligibility and uses an anti-chase surface score only for shortlist ordering.
assumptions.validation: 5D/10D/20D, benchmark excess, MAE/MFE, chronological 70/30 holdout, batch stability.
assumptions.surface: Each stage keeps its validated backend surface. The final cross-stage shortlist is capped at six by stage-rank round-robin; raw scores are never compared across stages and no quota is filled.

validation.method: purged chronological development split + sealed historical final period
validation.note: Historical final period is sealed from this point forward but is not claimed to be a virgin holdout because earlier project iterations had already observed this history. A truly untouched forward sample begins after 2026-09-27.

calendar.note: Shared experiment boundaries. Variant filtering must not recalculate these dates.

outputBoundary.note: Closed historical-final outcomes and boundary-crossing labels are excluded before every development summary, diagnostic and replay export.
